siftei_kohen.he: פטורים מק"ש. שעוסק במצוה פטור מהמצוה: **** ENGLISH **** Exempt from Keriat Shema. For one engaged in a mitzvah is exempt from the mitzvah.
siftei_kohen.en: Exemptively exempted from MKs. Complaining with an exemption from the Approval:

beer_hagolah.en: I cited this in Orach Chayyim siman 72.
